Title: An Episode in the Life of a Landscape Painter
Author: César Aira
My Review: A painter does not disguise himself as a painting. They seek not the surface of things but their essence and truth beneath their appearance. To see in this way is to risk dissolution, for perhaps the only way to truly "see" is to be undone by what you witness. Just as, in the end, the story is less about a man painting a landscape than about a landscape painting the man.
